opening.argument: The presentation actively solicits participation in OneCoin by combining dramatic appreciation and wealth claims with urgency and instructions to continue mining. It presents a 400% increase in coin value, states that there were “Almost 300 millionaires for 1 year,” and urges attendees, “So, make up your mind today.” The accompanying slide reinforces that earlier participation is better as mining difficulty grows, while another visually supports the 400% appreciation claim. The speaker further directs viewers that “you need to keep mining and mining coins,” linking continued business and mining activity to the prospect of increasing value and future gains. Taken together, these claims and calls to join early and participate establish promotional solicitation for a token-related opportunity.
